>        - .status.conditions

You should never have conflicts with both spec and status, so something is wrong here. You're probably not setting-up the "wiping" properly, I'll point it out specifically.

Then, if you still have conflict with maxReplicas, it's probably because you should be forcing.

> You should never have conflicts with both spec and status, so something is wrong here. You're probably not setting-up the "wiping" properly, I'll point it out specifically.

We have a test to check that people don't forget to add the reset fields, glad to see it's failing properly. You need to modify these two functions to indicate which fields need to be reset when apply spec/status:
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/registry/autoscaling/horizontalpodautoscaler/strategy.go#L50-L64
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/registry/autoscaling/horizontalpodautoscaler/strategy.go#L147-L163

issue_context.title: Create HPA v2 Stable API
issue_context.body:
#### What would you like to be added:

We need to create a new version v2 (no suffix) along with conversion routines, etc..

#### Why is this needed:

HPA v2beta2 is graduating to stable!  

- KEP: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-autoscaling/2702-graduate-hpa-api-to-GA
- Tracking issue: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/2702
- Working doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QGT9Waxc500ICGX_TGIoxfOWKmWbXYC6TWxfdUC2Njg/edit#
- Slack channel: #sig-autoscaling-api


#### What to do:

1. Read [Changing the API](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api_changes.md#changing-the-api), in particular [Making a New API Version](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api_changes.md#making-a-new-api-version).
2. Tell @josephburnett on #sig-autoscaling-api "_Hey, I want to do this._" (just so two people don't start the same work)
3. Create the new API and conversion routines.

#### Details:

The HPA controller [uses v2beta2](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/d541872f9a036ed4f792232e43fde6dacf0e1084/pkg/controller/podautoscaler/horizontal.go#L576-L583) as the internal structure.  So your conversion routines will be from v2 -> v2beta2 and back.  We will migrate the controller and associated code to v2 stable as a separate change.

Create the new API by copying v2beta2.  We are graduating the API as-is without adding any new fields.  However there are a few fields and enum values we would like to rename because they are confusing.

* Rename `MaxPolicySelect` to `MaxChangePolicySelect` and the [value](https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/api/autoscaling/v2beta2#ScalingPolicySelect) from `"Max"` to `"MaxChange"`.  The enum `MaxPolicySelect` will choose the smallest absolute value when scaling down (largest change) which has been confusing to customers.
* Rename `MinPolicySelect` to `MinChangePolicySelect` and the value from `"Min"` to `"MinChange"`.
* Rename `ResourceMetricSourceType` to `PodResourceMetricSourceType` and the [value](https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/api/autoscaling/v2beta2#MetricSourceType) from `"Resource"` to `"PodResource"`.  The new `"ContainerResource"` type makes `"Resource"` ambiguous.
* Rename the associated `ResourceMetricSource` [struct](https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/api/autoscaling/v2beta2#ResourceMetricSource).

Generate new code (see [Generating Code](https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/api/autoscaling/v2beta2#ScalingPolicySelect)).

Send a pull request (one squashed commit please) and notify #sig-autoscaling-api so we can take a look too.  It will probably need API review.

Feel free to reach out for help on #sig-autoscaling-api if you have any questions!
